summary: BTC is flat around $81-82k in a $74-88k range. Bullish on-chain and institutional talk is offset by a weekend sell-off in tokenized chip stocks and 'Black Monday' chatter ahead of the US open on 19 Oct. France's narrow vote to tax crypto-to-stablecoin swaps from 2027 is still pending Senate review. Mixed, neutral.
catalyst_note: France crypto-to-stablecoin swap tax passed Assembly 38-37 on 16 Oct, effective 2027 if it survives the Senate; minor, not BTC-specific
